status: exploratory; protocol fixed before new transfer outcomes; not external preregistration
refit: annual, label dates <= previous Dec31; purge by direct horizon
transfer_definition: For each held-out state, fit regression coefficients and feature standardization only to other two states. Historical target-state context and its fixed pre-year mean/std normalization are permitted. This is held-out-regression-region transfer, not no-history cold start or wholly unseen target information. No state identity code.
normalization: For each state use mean/std from preceding 730 recorded-label days before year; normalize its historical level features/target with these values; std/trend features divide by std without centering. Target state scaling is permitted historical context and not source fitting.
hyperparameter_selection: None; alpha=10 fixed for every arm and state; no held-out-region errors select features/parameters. Source and destination data all precede held-out year; no future-year data are pooled.
history_features: same prespecified rich design as strong_refit_v1; do not modify after baseline outcomes
cases: same historical expanded daily origins, three states, leads 1/7/14, 2024-26 partial. All arms share recorded labels/cases.
scaling: same fixed pre-year observed weekly-difference MASE scale
reporting: compare leave_region_out versus local and pooled_all for each mode/state/year/lead/all/event/non-event; save training state identities, label cutoff and normalizers; no claim of zero-shot foundation-model transfer
limits: three related regions from same source, not independent source replication
only two primary historical event years
future event-year extrapolation is forward-only, not leave-future-year-in-training
historical target context and normalization are allowed; not a strict geographic cold start
